variant_desc: qsort of 1e6 ints in range [0,100) -> counting sort O(n + range) (variant 2: seed=44, n_scale=1.5x)
novelty_rationale: Tests recognition that small value-range data should use counting sort, not comparison sort. The input characteristic (range << n) is what enables the algorithmic improvement; no compiler can switch from qsort to counting sort based on runtime value distribution.
